name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: Give $000$ the empty sample and give $011,101$ respectively their positive examples $(x_1,1),(x_2,1)$. The latter two samples are inconsistent with $000$ and with each other, so this is a positive no-clashing map of width one. Width zero is impossible for a non-singleton class. Hence $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}=1$; the map is checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition; see \cite{KSZ2019} for positive NCTD.
